page.notes: Doubtful readings: "cunctis" (the print looks like "cuctnis"; it may be "cunctis", marked [?]). The hyphen in "condem-natam" and "Ga-" is printed at the line end. The running head reads "De sana, sive recta Ratione" with long s. The catchword "briele" is the start of the next page's first word ("Gabriele"). The words "ab Angelo" and "prout" may be set in roman rather than italic; the italic span is an estimate. Faint stains at the lower left are not transcribed.
